{{Top|leg}}
'''Sub-q injectors''' were a type of injector that were used to drug a victim.<ref name="Prize">{{StoryCite|story=The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] used sub-q injectors, alongside [[neural stunner]]s and [[shock panel]]s, as part of the security system aboard the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]''.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> A sub-q injector was once used by [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to drug [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]].<ref name="Prize" />
